title: She grew up in a small Haryana town dreaming of flight. On this day, she left the atmosphere.

sources.text: The Better India - Kalpana Chawla's journey from Karnal to space

caption:
She grew up in a small Haryana town dreaming of flight. On this day, she left the atmosphere.

Chawla was born and raised in Karnal, Haryana, where she earned her aeronautical engineering degree at Punjab Engineering College before moving to the US for graduate study. STS-87 was her first of two spaceflights.

Chawla logged over 372 hours in space across her two missions. She remains one of the most widely recognized symbols of what an Indian engineering education can lead to, inspiring a generation of students toward science and space careers.

Chawla's path - small-town India to a Space Shuttle flight deck - is still the reference point for what's possible when that ambition is matched with the right training.
